user.title: Connect to UniFi Drive
user.description: Enter your UniFi OS host and credentials.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate UniFi Drive
reauth_confirm.description: Your session expired or credentials changed. Enter the password for {username} on {host}.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure UniFi Drive
reconfigure.description: Update the connection settings. Leave the password blank to keep the current one.

error.auth: Login failed. Check credentials or 2FA (use a local account).
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the host. Check the host, network and SSL settings.
error.rate_limit: Login was rate-limited by the controller. Wait a few minutes and try again.

abort.already_configured: This host and username are already configured.

init.title: UniFi Drive Options
init.description: Adjust how often UniFi Drive is polled.

dump_api.name: Dump API responses
dump_api.description: Queries every known UniFi Drive controller endpoint and writes one JSON file per endpoint, showing all the data the appliance exposes. The files are not redacted and contain serial numbers, MAC addresses and IP addresses.

config_entry_id.name: Integration entry
config_entry_id.description: Which UniFi Drive appliance to query. Only needed when more than one is configured.

output_dir.name: Output directory
output_dir.description: Directory to write the JSON files into, relative to the configuration directory. Created if missing.

extra_paths.name: Extra paths
extra_paths.description: Additional absolute API paths to query, for example /api/system.
